title: The test suite does not pass on Windows: 7 failures and a hang
goal: python _tools/tests.py exits 0 on Windows (Python 3.14 via uv, Git for Windows sh on PATH), with no test failing and none hanging.
notes: Needs a Windows machine: work it in a Windows session of this clone. Evidence: kb-tests-windows job 16789774076 at commit 66cc0a1 (754 tests, 2 xdist workers) printed 7 F between 28% and 57%, then no output after 85% for 16 minutes until it was cancelled; the log names no test (xdist prints dots). The repro passes on macOS and Linux.
